title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Billing Rules for One-Time Charges
content:
One-time charges under **Area and Security Lighting Rental** are billed only for what the crew actually did or the member caused. Each is billed on the service account the light is billed on, at the figure the schedule of one-time charges gives for the light's fixture.

## The charges and what each is billed for

| Charge | Billed for |
|---|---|
| Additional pole charge | Each additional pole set for the light, per pole |
| Underground feed charge | Each foot of underground feed installed, per foot, where the fixture allows an underground feed |
| Shield charge | A house-side shield added to the light |
| Member-owned pole inspection fee | A member-owned pole the fixture is mounted on, where the fixture allows mounting on a member-owned pole |
| Relocation charge | A relocation of the light, where the fixture allows relocation |
| Fixture damage charge | A fixture damaged by the member or the member's guests |
| Pole damage charge | A light pole broken by the member's vehicle or equipment |
| Cancellation-after-staking fee | A request the member cancels after the location was staked |

Mounting on an existing cooperative pole costs the existing-pole mounting charge, which is 0.00 for every fixture.

## What is never charged

- **Lamp and photocell failures** are never charged, because photocells and lamps are replaced at no charge for every fixture.
- **Storm or third-party damage** is never charged to the member. The fixture damage charge and the pole damage charge apply only when the damage was caused by the member or the member's guests, equipment or vehicles.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | One-time charge? |
|---|---|
| The crew set one additional pole | The additional pole charge, once |
| The crew did not set a pole that was planned | No additional pole charge for that pole: only work actually done is billed |
| A lamp burned out | No |
| A photocell failed and the light burns by day | No |
| A storm broke the fixture | No |
| Someone other than the member or the member's guests damaged the fixture | No |
| The member's guest damaged the fixture | The fixture damage charge |
| The member's tractor broke the light pole | The pole damage charge |

### Hypothetical figures

- The crew sets one additional pole and runs 60 feet of underground feed for an LED 70W Area Light, and adds a shield. The one-time charges are one pole at 325.00, 60 feet at 6.50 per foot (390.00), and the shield at 45.00, three charges totalling 760.00.
- A member's truck backs into the pole of an LED 40W Security Light and breaks it: the pole damage charge of 650.00 is billed.
